# Test pages

Real pages of voebb.de, captured on 2026-09-25 with two accounts:

- `start.html`, `login.html`, `logged_in.html`, `account_no_loans.html`
- `account_with_loans.html`, `loans.html`
- `renew_check.html`: the Ausleihen page after "Markierte Medien verlängerbar?" for one item

Names, pickup codes, card expiry dates, session values and the borrowed items (titles, authors,
call numbers, barcodes, library) are replaced.
